name: Wire Walk
design_intent:
WIRE WALK — THE HIGH WIRE #6 (tier 2, two thin ridges + a gap). Two 1000px thin trampoline ridges (h56) hang in a dusk sky over a deep void, split by ONE 620px flight-required gap, with a single spring throne floating high over the gap. Steps up from Catwalk's single strip: now there is a real crossing between two exposed ridges AND a boost-only high prize, so combat happens ON the wire and ACROSS the gap. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the two-ridge crossing (Catwalk is one strip; the_spine adds outboard perches). Feel = 'fight along your wire, then commit the boost across the abyss to theirs.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 620px in ~0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Left ridge x0..1000 top860; right ridge x1620..2620 top860; throne spring x1130..1490 top340:
- GAP left<->right ridge: ridge-edge-to-edge = 620px over the void. 620 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395 (trampoline). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the deep void. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top y340): 520px above the ridge tops (860), hanging over the open gap. Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y590 -> 270px short; an under-shot drops down the gap into the void. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER earns it). (Rule B, >= 520.)
- RECOVER: ridge bottom 916 -> bottom blast line 1900 = 984px of open sky over the void (>= 650, Rule D) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back onto a wire; a near-brink smash or starved victim rings out. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce clears the 620px gap or the 520px throne climb, so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
